name: Logan County, OK
findings: Logan County has 79 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Logan County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Logan County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 63% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
